Bull.story: About 30 GW installed by 2031 renting near $20B per GW-year: Super Intelligence revenue about $600B at a 35% operating margin; Starlink compounds about 27% a year from its run-rate as V3 and Mobile V2 fill; Starship makes Space profitable. 35× a business still growing fast.

Base.story: Management's 13 GW lands about a year late, then about 15 GW renting near $16B per GW-year as GPU prices deflate: Super Intelligence revenue about $250B at a cloud-like 25% margin; Starlink about 17% a year at 45%; 2% a year dilution from stock pay and funding.

Bear.story: Compute turns into a commodity: rental prices fall faster than chips depreciate, Super Intelligence revenue stalls near $120B at a 12% margin, and the build is funded partly with equity sold low (4.5% a year dilution). Starlink keeps growing but cannot carry the price.

optionality.name: Orbital compute and Musk's $500B+ ARR path
optionality.story: Musk's end-2027 ARR target of $500B–$1T met and sustained, then orbital data centers on a reusable Starship; possible, not plausible

optionality.name: Tesla merger: premium paid to Tesla holders
optionality.story: about a 4% transfer of value to Tesla holders if the deal closes on PW terms (see the merger chapter)
